descriptions.description: Inflorescència sense fulla involucrant; fulles totes peciolades, amb 3-7 parells de folíols laterals. Herba glabrescent, multicaule, anual, difusa; fulles imparipinnades, amb els folíols oblongs; estípules molt petites, linears, les superiors sovint nul.les; 1-5 flors grogues, de 6-8 mm, en glomèrul llargament pedunculat; fruit de 2-3,5 cm, arcuat, glabrescent, poc comprimit, amb (6)8-12 segments separats per constriccions poc marcades; bec terminal curt. Th. e. 4-30(50) cm. IV-V.

Ornithopus pinnatus, the orange birdsfoot, is a plant in the Fabaceae family. It was first described as Scorpiurus pinnata in 1768 by Philip Miller in The Gardeners Dictionary. In 1907, George Claridge Druce assigned it to the genus Ornithopus. It is native to Western Europe, the Mediterranean Region and Macaronesia but is found elsewhere as an introduced species.
